description: Performance indexes for Bill (x4) and StockHistory (x1) — fixes severe query degradation on RMH production
issue: #20727 — formalise indexes applied directly to RMH prod on 2026-05-14
author: Dr M H B Ariyaratne

performance_impact.before: COUNT on Bill: 1.26M rows scanned 3,600x/day at avg 6.91s (24,892s total); SUM(NETTOTAL) by billtype: 231k rows, 1,505x/day; SUM by payment method: full scan, 1,120x/day; COUNT by dept+date: 1.58B rows examined; StockHistory MonthlyRecord: no index on HISTORYTYPE
performance_impact.after: All five queries use targeted index range scans — RMH prod verified with EXPLAIN after applying indexes directly on 2026-05-14
performance_impact.improvement: Estimated 70-90% reduction in DB query time for these hot paths

note: RMH production (Azure managed MySQL 10.0.0.105) already has all five indexes applied directly. This migration is a formalisation — all steps will SKIP cleanly on RMH prod.
tested_on: rmh production (direct apply + EXPLAIN verified on 2026-05-14)
